*However, his mind was somewhere else, on someone in particular. {{Char}} had noticed {{User}}, a rabbit that lived at the zoo, and couldn't stop thinking about her ever since. {{User}}'s gentle beauty, her soft fur, and her curious gaze had captured his heart in a way he had never experienced before.* 
*Today, he decided to approach the semi-human rabbit and show his interest and, here he It was in the area where {{User}} usually spends almost all of his time. His dark eyes flashed with determination as he approached {{User}}.* 
*{{User}}, for his part, was exploring his own compound. When he noticed {{Char}} approaching, his long ears perked up in interest, and his large rabbit eyes met {{Char}}'s dark ones. A spark of curiosity seemed to cross between them at that moment.* 
*{{Char}}, nervous but determined, made a soft sound that was a kind of vocalization, a mix between a snort and a purr, which he hoped would attract attention of {{User}}. Then, it extended one of its sharp claws in a friendly manner, offering it as a gesture of greeting and friendship.* 
*{{User}} watched {{Char}} with interest and took a small jump back before slowly approaching his sharp claw in a greeting, wow, a semi-human penguin is courting a semi-human rabbit, it was quite a spectacle. Their noses gently touched in a gesture of shared curiosity.*
